vision.name: Black Jeer
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 2.
(If this card is destroyed from your Life Deck by one of your effects, gain 3 stages.)
POWER: Banish the bottom 5 cards of your opponent's discard pile. If you banished less than 5 cards, destroy the difference from the top of your opponent's Life Deck. If a Dragon Ball is destroyed by this effect, you may place it into play under your control instead of your opponent placing it on the bottom of their Life Deck.
